_comment: Entries MISSING from Sterling's product-data workbook, verified against their own site before being added. The ingest merges these AFTER building from the workbook, so they survive a re-ingest. Remove an entry once Sterling ship a file that contains it.

5055160080800._why: Dewalt Albany Slim Work Trousers, 30 Waist / 31 Leg. Absent from the 2026-01-08 workbook (0 occurrences; the sizes either side are present), which blocked the whole Sterling run on 2026-08-28. Size L31W30 confirmed on sterling.famlive.net via a worker dry-run: matchedSize 30, ready true.

5055160080886._why: Dewalt Albany Slim Work Trousers, 32 Waist / 33 Leg (LONG). Absent from the workbook (error id 185, PO 487461, 2026-09-07). NOT verified against the live site with a worker dry-run this time (Sterling's basket is unreadable from here, so a stage() add can't be proven cleared afterwards) — instead cross-checked against data already trusted in sterlingProducts.json: Brightpearl's own size string for this product (261791) is '32 Waist, 33 Leg (LONG)', which is exactly search=Albany colour=Grey/Black size=L33W32 — the SAME style/colour/size cell as EAN 5055160085652, already present and presumably working in the workbook-derived data. Two EANs mapping to one portal cell is expected (Sterling's site has no EAN granularity); if this turns out wrong, delete this entry and check the L33W32 cell on the live site by hand before re-adding.

5063777009268._why: DeWalt Wilbury Two Pack T-Shirts, XXL. Absent from the Sterling product-data workbook entirely — not one Wilbury EAN of any size appears in sterlingProducts.json, so this is not a single missing row but the whole product line never having been ingested. Blocked PO 488289 (error id 231, 2026-09-10). Verified against the live site with a read-only worker inspect() (no basket add): searching "Wilbury" returns a single unambiguous result, styleid=WILBURY ("wilbury dewalt two pack t-shrits", score 100, no colour conflict), with a S/M/L/XL/XXL grid at £11.66 each and XXL showing 398 in stock. Colour kept as Brightpearl has it ("Djion & Navy", likely their own typo for Dijon) since the portal has no separate colour variant to match against — the single search result is enough. If Sterling ship a workbook that contains this EAN, delete this entry.

5063777009237._why: DeWalt Wilbury Two Pack T-Shirts, M. Same absence as the XXL entry above — the whole product line was missing from the workbook, not one row — so this size would have blocked a Sterling run the first time anyone ordered it, exactly as XXL blocked PO 488289 on 2026-09-10. Added at the same time rather than waiting for it to fail: the worker inspect() that verified XXL returned the full grid in one read, S/M/L/XL/XXL at GBP 11.66 with stock 0/1035/1330/1028/398, so M (1035 in stock) is confirmed by the same evidence. Brightpearl carries M/L/XL/XXL only (product group 16619); Sterling also list an S, but we hold no S product so there is no EAN to key an override on. Colour kept as Brightpearl has it ("Djion & Navy") for the same reason as XXL. If Sterling ship a workbook that contains this EAN, delete this entry.
